standards.standard_name: USDA National Organic Program (7 CFR Part 205)
standards.accrediting_authority: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS)
standards.regulatory_citation: Title 7, Code of Federal Regulations, Part 205 (7 CFR Part 205)

excluded_dimension_rationales.fair_wages_and_labor_conditions: OFPA statute (7 U.S.C. 6501) limits NOP authority to organic production/handling; no labor/wage mandate.
excluded_dimension_rationales.living_wage_and_fair_pricing: 7 CFR Part 205 contains no price floors or social premiums.
excluded_dimension_rationales.carbon_neutrality_and_ghg_emissions: No greenhouse gas metrics or carbon neutrality requirements exist under NOP.
excluded_dimension_rationales.shipping_and_transport_emissions: Post-harvest transport logistics emissions outside NOP regulatory scope.
excluded_dimension_rationales.biodegradable_packaging: 7 CFR §205.272 restricts packaging contamination but permits conventional food-grade plastics/foil.
